dimension_description: Scoville heat units are a familiar rough scale for pungency from capsaicinoids. They are not a fundamental physical unit, but they are pedagogically useful for comparing mild peppers, hot sauces, pepper sprays, and nearly pure capsaicin. Reported values often come as ranges, so the entries here use representative central values.
